audit.definition: Correct original CSV row 5 latitude to 34.5 N and row 8 longitude to 146 E from Yamamoto & Kanamatsu (2001), p.56 and coring-location maps. Preserve 7 and 6 cm confirmed by Yamamoto & Aoki (2002), Tables 1/2, p.31 and correlations p.32. Encode CSV 43 upper 10 cm; CSV 52 lower 3 cm; CSV 53 lower 6.7 cm following Table S2, retaining the primary-paper 6.5–7 cm conflict; CSV 55 lower 7 cm as a preservation sensitivity. Keep all other quantitative records and the six excluded pseudo rows. Fill S2 source references without changing row order.

strict.definition: Exact-site Delaunay triangles: longest edge / minimum vertex third-neighbor distance and circumdiameter / median vertex third-neighbor distance both <= spacing factor.
strict.interpretation: Geometry-screened interpolation footprint, not a confidence region, deposit boundary, or guarantee of representativeness. Bounds alone do not establish two-sided local support.

strict.scope: Integral on the explicitly supplied regional geometry; no global integral.
strict.median_surface_note: Integral of pointwise median thickness; not the median of the volume distribution.
strict.uncertainty: Geographic-deletion sensitivity only; not a confidence interval. Common footprint held fixed. Selection-adjusted volume intervals are not supplied.

contours.level_rule: 25 equally spaced log-thickness levels between exact-observation 5th and 95th percentiles.
contours.scope: Entire-contour geometric support, three-site bracketing, grid refinement and four fully retuned geographic deletions. Eligibility is a development screen, not a probability or guarantee that unsampled fallout is absent.
contours.uncertainty: No selection-adjusted band or global confidence interval is claimed. Interpolation-footprint uncertainty is reported separately from extrapolation scenarios.
